title: Finished time or unfinished time?
body_md:
Use the **Past Simple** when the time is finished and stated or clear: *yesterday*, *last year*, *in 2020*, *two days ago*.

Use the **Present Perfect** (*have/has + past participle*) when the time is not stated or is still going on: *ever*, *never*, *already*, *yet*, *since*, *for*, *this week*.

- I **saw** that film last night.
- I **have seen** that film twice.
- She **has worked** here since 2022.
